item.title: Zaturn Zero VCF8 and a Beat
item.description: video upload by gotharman "Tweaking the new VCF8 analog filters a bit, and later I tweak the beat. The kick, snare and chorus sounds are also shaped with VCF8. VCF8 is based on the Urano VCF51. Such a characterful and punchy filter :)" www.gotharman.dk

item.title: Georgia Tech Announces 28th Annual Guthman Musical Instrument Competition Finalists
item.description: video upload by Georgia Tech School of Music "Ten innovators from six countries have advanced to the competition's final round. They will meet on the Georgia Tech campus in Atlanta, Georgia on March 13 and 14, 2026, to compete for $10,000 in prizes. Each finalist and their instrument has a compelling story — these are the world's next generation of musical instruments." Press
